proposals.mechanism: Cannon or held-tool launch creates independently saved FluidEffectProjectile carrying real FluidStack slice, then debits corresponding source tank/tool; tool multishot divides finite volume between shots. Projectile own disk pair restores full fluid plus power/knockback/water inertia and optional cannon position. Actual entity/block effects return consumed volume, shrink carried stock and permit piercing/continuation while fluid remains. Effects use current fluid recipe lookup rather than saved effect cache. Cannon-backed shot resolves current loaded block capability and current slot0 at impact, copies context stack and may write changed stack back.
proposals.dedup: Acceptedf46 owns cannon tank/implement read/write; its shared launch is support0 here, not recrediting cannon. This proposal owns transferred in-flight fluid after source debit, including actual partial consumption and separately persistent remainder. Botania418 already owns generic carried mana and collision receipts; simple projectile serialization alone0. Concrete incremental boundary is volume-scaled effect execution with repeated targets/block neighbors and late binding to mutable external cannon inventory; no projectile-specific collision receipt list observed. Trollc40 carries single block, not divisible fluid effect balance. Held module and each fluid/effect type share this one owner, add0 individually.
limits: Cannon link stores BlockPos only, no dimension or cannon UUID. Actual getCannonInventory accepts any loaded block entity with modifiable item handler, not necessarily original cannon. Replacing or moving context can bind another inventory; not original tool snapshot preservation.

Entity impact writes context stack only if consumed>0. Block impact returning early because struck block is now air and fluid remains (288-290) bypasses later updateCannonStack(301-302), so do not claim every successful effect persists context mutations.
No addFreshEntity result check before tank/tool fluid debit. Spawning and source consumption not atomic; creative/resource-exempt held users intentionally skip debit.
Reader restores raw power/knockback/water inertia with getFloat defaults0. Public inertia setter caps0.99, but reader bypasses setter. No custom finite/range validation observed.

Projectile owns liquid remainder rather than permanent player progress. Unrecognized/currently removed fluid effect recipe can cause no effect and block-hit discard; no historical recipe snapshot.
